```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
base <- "https://www.bgee.org/ftp/bgee_v15_0/download/processed_expr_values/rna_seq/Caenorhabditis_elegans"
expr_url  <- file.path(base, "Caenorhabditis_elegans_RNA-Seq_read_counts_TPM_FPKM_SRP000401.tsv.gz")
meta_url  <- file.path(base, "Caenorhabditis_elegans_RNA-Seq_experiments_libraries.tar.gz") 

# Download
download.file(expr_url, destfile = "SRP000401_expr.tsv.gz", mode = "wb")

# Load Data Matrix
library(data.table)
expr <- fread(cmd = paste("gzip -dc", shQuote("SRP000401_expr.tsv.gz")))

clean_df <- subset(expr, `Stage name` == "embryo stage" & Strain == "N2") %>% 
        select(c("Gene ID","FPKM"))

colnames(clean_df) <- c("Gene_ID","FPKM")

# Save Clean file
write_tsv(clean_df, "~/DPhil/R_Data/C_elegans_Embryonic_Expression.tsv")

```
